summary: You may be able to show more of who you are without preparing a defense first.
body: You may be able to show more of who you are without preparing a defense first. When the Sun trines Lilith, visibility is less likely to depend on making the inconvenient, unconventional, or less polished part of yourself easier for other people to approve. Wear it, say it, publish it, choose it, or let the preference stand without adding a long explanation. The useful part of this transit is not becoming shocking. It is discovering how little energy you need to spend apologizing for something that was never actually a problem.
